units.source_text: 还望教导小姐，使她稍稍谅解我心。

en.t: Please guide the young lady, so that she may come to understand my heart a little.

units.source_text: 倘若我能忍耐，何必以此种风情之事相托？”

en.t: If I could endure it, why would I ask you to help me with such a matter of love?"

units.source_text: 妹尼僧读了来书，比中将更觉难过，眼泪流个不住，便写回信：

en.t: His younger sister, the nun, read the letter and felt even more distressed than the Captain; her tears would not stop, and she wrote back:
